purpose: 50 labelled messages (25 English, 25 Spanish; 25 Rebalance, 25 Voice command) for testing Jev, OpenAI Decisions and Cloudflare Clef with typed questions.

rebalance.name: over_by
rebalance.instructions: How far over its calorie target is the Member's day, according to what they said? Level 0 = just a bit over (under about 10%), 1 = somewhat over (about 10-25%), 2 = clearly over (about 25-50%), 3 = far over (about 50-100%), 4 = way over (more than double, or they say so)

rebalance.name: meal
rebalance.instructions: Which Meal Time did the Member overeat at?

rebalance.name: fix
rebalance.instructions: What kind of fix does the Member want? lighter_later_today = shrink a later meal today; lighter_tomorrow = shrink tomorrow's meals; drop_if_room_meal = drop an If room meal; no_preference = they did not ask for a particular fix

rebalance.name: gave_number
rebalance.instructions: Did the Member state a specific calorie number?

voice.name: action
voice.instructions: Which action does the spoken command most likely ask for?

choices.description: Tick a Shopping list line Bought.
Add an item to the Shopping list.
Log a planned Portion at a Meal Time.
Log something else that was eaten or drunk.
Mark a Pantry item used up or partly used.
Start a Rebalance after the day went over.

voice.name: has_amount
voice.instructions: Does the command contain an amount or quantity (a number, a weight, a fraction or a count)?
